flags: Venue abroad (Costa Rica): the venue quotes in US dollars. Our Bay Area price sheet does not apply abroad: lines the venue has not priced show unknown (ask the venue or a local supplier).
Capacity not stated: ask the venue. The guest slider runs to 1,000.

notes.t: From the venue's documents: Tropical square ceremony arch: $625
35% off published room rates for wedding guests booking direct; 3-night minimum
Fee covers ceremony venue, day coordination, small cake, bouquet and boutonniere
Food and drink priced separately, plus 13% VAT, 10% service, 15% banquet fee; no outside food or corkage
Banquet charges: 13% VAT, 10% service charge, 15% banquet fee
Cash bar minimum spend $2,500 + taxes
Room commitment usually starts at about 8 rooms; non-staying guests may pay a day-use fee
May 1, 2027 sold out; Memorial Day weekend not available
Venue said $20,000 fits only about 20 to 30 guests, not 175
Website check: Wedding fee $7,750 (email) is not on the site, which says 'For pricing, contact our wedding specialist: events@thespringscostarica.com' (email matches record). No conflict.
Website check: Site phone is reservations 2401-3300; record phone (506) 2401-3351 is the events line from the email. No conflict.

Website check: Coordinates from OpenStreetMap object 'The Springs Resort and Spa, Calle Arenal Springs' (postcode 21012); the other OSM object 'Arenal Springs Resort & Spa' is a different hotel. Site gives no max capacity.
Biggest wedding space is Rancho Club Rio, up to 150 guests; ceremony maximum is Aracari Plaza at 150. our 175 to 200 guests do not fit any listed space
Rancho Club Rio rental from $1,950++ for 6 to 10 pm
Rancho Club Rio extra hours from $650++ per hour, up to 1:00 am
Pillars Terrace (up to 60) from $800++ and Tree Tops (up to 50) from $850++, each 6 to 10 pm, semi-private
Buffets 2027 per person: Pura Vida Tico $138++, Arenal Rainforest $142++, Springs Signature $159++, Mediterranean $162++
Plated dinner (two starters, two entrees, one dessert) $170++ per person
Deluxe open bar per person: $94++ 2 hours, $114++ 3 hours, $136++ 4 hours, $166++ 5 hours
Premium open bar per person: $114++ 2 hours up to $198++ 5 hours
Hors d'oeuvres per dozen: vegetarian $74++, meat $88++, seafood $96++; stations $68++ to $82++ per person; dessert table $36++
Shared family-style dinners $180++ to $220++ per person
Payments: 30% non-refundable wedding fee deposit at signing, second payment 120 days out, balance 45 days out
Room block: 10% non-refundable at signing, 40% at 120 days, final 50% at 90 days
Cancellation: 90 days or less = 100% of contracted event value
Open bar for kids: 0 to 4 free, 5 to 15 half price
Outside vendors allowed with prior written approval; ceremony venue is included for up to two hours
Event hours can be extended for a fee, subject to venue availability
Extra adult in a room $60 + tax per night; child 5+ $50; check-in 3:30 pm, check-out 11:30 am
Wedding guests get 20% off Sanctuary Spa and 10% off Club Rio activities
Floral price list 2027: tropical square ceremony arch $625, spring arch $950; centerpieces $10 to $100
Dessert selection (5 per person) $28++
Legal marriage officiant $850 + VAT (Marcelo Galli) or $925 + VAT (Castro Calzada); symbolic $600 to $900 + VAT
